Game Overview

At its heart, Block the View is a jigsaw puzzle game about quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

Playing Block the View comes down to a simple loop. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Block the View?

Block the View is a free jigsaw puzzle game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Block the View free to play?

Yes, Block the View is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
